title: eat shit & die 134
author: bpatrick
html: A little solipsistic story that was fun to draw. I’ve got more ideas for Onan in the future. We’ll probably have a MSFM around Wednesday, maybe a Curious Urgency before the end of the week and then on to some new Vivian Blank. Just thought I’d share: if you haven’t read Hey, wait… by Jason yet, do yourself a favor. I just read it this week and it’s the real deal.
